name: ScreenTinker
summary: Ultra-low-power digital signage & dashboard client with 8MB PSRAM caching, 6-digit pairing, and captive portal.
description: ScreenTinker turns your reTerminal Sticky into an ultra-low-power, wireless digital signage display. Features direct 1-bit SSD1677 bitstream streaming, 8MB PSRAM in-memory frame cache for instant button navigation, server-coordinated deep sleep with ETag caching, seamless 6-digit PIN pairing, and a smartphone Captive Portal.

compatibility.notes: Tested on Seeed Studio reTerminal Sticky production hardware with 3.97-inch E-Paper and ESP32-S3.

notes.title: USB Connection & Web Flashing
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB-C data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge.

notes.title: Dual Onboarding Setup
notes.description: After flashing, connect your smartphone to the 'ScreenTinker-Setup' Wi-Fi hotspot to configure Wi-Fi and Server URL via the popup setup portal, or use tools/sticky-installer.html via USB.

notes.title: 6-Digit Pairing Code
notes.description: Once Wi-Fi is connected, the Sticky will display a 6-digit pairing code on screen. In your ScreenTinker dashboard, click '+ Add Display' and enter the code.
